questions.solution_text:
The circle $x^{2}+y^{2}=4$ has radius $r=2$.
The region is the upper half of that circle.
$\int_{-2}^{2}\sqrt{4-x^{2}}\,dx=\frac{1}{2}\pi r^{2}$
$=\frac{1}{2}\pi(2)^{2}$
$=2\pi$
